description: Process a covered name's earnings event: pull the print, transcript, and filings; analyze the call; update and audit the coverage model; then stage a post-earnings note draft for senior-analyst review without publishing.

dependencies.purpose: Own earnings-call analysis after the packet is assembled.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services --skill earnings-analysis -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Plug reported actuals into the coverage model.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services --skill model-update -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex
npx skills add https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services --skill audit-xls -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Draft the post-earnings note for senior-analyst review without publishing.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services --skill morning-note -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Optional plugin umbrella for packet intake; individual financial-services skills are the required routing targets.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services --skill earnings-analysis model-update audit-xls morning-note xlsx-author -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Pull reported actuals, consensus, and filings when a live FactSet connector is available
Pull standardized actuals when a live Daloopa connector is available
